body: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game character-selection art-only background, widescreen 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input image 1 is the exact composition/style reference; input image 2 is supporting environment/style reference. Recreate this original Chinese xianxia environment in rich detailed painterly NPR game cinematic style: Chinese stone moon gate behind the hero, distant mist-wreathed karst temple peaks, floating mountain temples, carved wet stone platform, restrained bronze details, warm sunset and braziers contrasted against cool slate mist. Match image 1 camera/framing: full-body selected hero at horizontal 65%, head near 10% image height and feet at 92%, grounded naturally on platform. Leftmost 30% must be very dark low-detail empty gradient for UI overlay, seamlessly blended into scene, no objects or characters drawing attention there. Remove ALL interface from the references: NO text, letters, numbers, buttons, plaques, portraits, icons, border frames, HUD, logos or watermarks. Preserve beautiful full scene only, not a screenshot of UI. Detailed flowing cloth and Chinese cultural styling, not low-poly, not Western fantasy. Hero: Duanyue martial cultivator, robust adult Chinese man, athletic human proportions NOT an oversized fantasy barbarian. Rugged black hair tied in a bun with some loose locks, short black beard, composed determined face. Ivory and charcoal layered martial robes with bronze bracers, sash and practical boots. Bare fists held naturally at his sides with subtle warm ember glow around knuckles; anatomically correct hands. No sword. Full body entirely inside canvas.
